text:
sara (Support): @anya heads-up — Velocis onboarding demo failed just now. Customer couldn't auth to sandbox (API key mismatch) and got repeated 503s when we tried embeddings. Renewal review is next Mon; they're frustrated. Need CS to own comms + remediation. :rotating_light:

tom (Support Lead): Repro steps posted to #eng-runtime. Immediate workaround: switch them to the legacy demo key so the scheduled demo can continue. Can infra bump their sandbox quota temporarily?

mike (Solutions Eng): Logs show client requested model v1.2 but routing sent v1.1 pool — small config mismatch. Trace id: trace-7f3b. Recommend routing them to v1.2-compatible pool or flip their client config.

anya (CS Lead): Ok. Amanda, can you lead customer comms? Draft reply should: 1) acknowledge, 2) give immediate workaround (legacy key + quota bump), 3) set ETA for manual fix (2h) and permanent patch (24h). I'll own escalation with eng. @mike please coordinate with eng-runtime.

amanda (CS Manager): On it. I can hop on an emergency call at 10:30am PT. Drafting a one-paragraph message to post to Velocis Slack/Email now.

mike (Solutions Eng): I'll ping eng-runtime and attach the trace + config diff. @deploy-bot can you open a P1 incident and tag eng-runtime + infra oncall?

deploy-bot: P1 incident opened — INC-2245. Notifying eng-runtime, infra, and oncall. Link: https://internal.incidents/INC-2245

tom (Support Lead): Remediation plan proposal: (A) immediate: switch demo to legacy key (we verified that works), (B) bump sandbox tokens + API quota by 20% for 48h, (C) schedule patch tonight 11pm PT to fix routing. Agree?

anya (CS Lead): Yes. Assignments: amanda -> customer comms & scheduling, mike -> technical patch coordination with eng-runtime, tom -> quota bump with infra. I'll own renewal outreach if Velocis asks for concession. SLA: customer notified within 30m.

amanda (CS Manager): Draft message (short):
"Hi Velocis — we're sorry about the interruption during your demo. We identified an auth/routing issue causing 503s. Short term: use the legacy demo key we just DM'd you; we've increased your sandbox quota for the next 48h. We're scheduling a permanent fix tonight and will confirm when complete. Thanks for the patience — Amanda, Customer Success"

sara (Support): Customer replied in-channel: "Legacy key works, demo unblocked — please confirm timeline for permanent fix." They seem less upset but want assurance.

anya (CS Lead): Good. Amanda — send the message now and CC renewals. Also offer a goodwill credit (1 week additional dev sandbox) to be safe. I'll update renewal owner with this incident note.

amanda (CS Manager): Sent to Velocis and CC'd renewals. Created 30-min follow-up for tomorrow. Paste of sent message included in the incident.

mike (Solutions Eng): Eng-runtime acknowledged and scheduled the patch for 23:00 PT. Will monitor after deploy and post verification logs to INC-2245.

deploy-bot: INC-2245 updated: patch scheduled 2024-11-06T23:00:00-08:00. Notified watchers.

tom (Support Lead): Monitoring for 24h post-patch. If no regression, we'll close the incident and Amanda will follow up with renewal owner.

anya (CS Lead): Thanks everyone. Amanda — please add the comms copy + timeline to the renewal ticket. We'll reconvene if Velocis escalates further. :thumbsup:
